tabs.bundlesHint: Your drafts and the bundles other players published to JKNet Online

drafts.heading: Drafts
drafts.empty: No drafts yet. Start one with New bundle, or make one out of a client with Create bundle from client on its card.
drafts.linkedHint: Bound to a published bundle: the next publish adds a version to it
drafts.confirmBody: The draft and the files copied into it are removed from this computer. A bundle it was published as stays in the catalogue, and clients made out of it stay where they are.

toolbar.myBundlesSignIn: Sign in to see your bundles

list.emptyText: A bundle is a set of clients another player put together: engines, files and settings, ready to install. Build one of yours in the editor and publish it.
list.filteredText: Try another word, another order or another engine.
list.errorTitle: The catalogue could not be read
list.unsupported: This JKNet Online does not serve bundles yet. It needs the service version with bundles; until then the catalogue stays empty.

details.engineUnknown: This component needs the {{engine}} engine, which this version of JKNet does not know. Update the launcher to install it.

overlay.replacesHash: Replaces the release file with SHA-256

details.noOverlay: The engine files are the release as published.
details.noFiles: No files of its own: the engine and the settings alone.
details.modifiedHint: Changed since it was taken from JKHub: the bundle carries this copy, not the one jkhub.org serves
details.modifiedOrigin: Changed by the author after it was taken from JKHub file {{id}}: the bundle carries this copy
details.executableWarning: An executable file. JKNet cannot tell what it does: install this bundle only if you trust its author.

install.heading: Install
install.noVersion: This bundle has no published version to install.
install.baseNameHint: Each component becomes a client named after this and its label, such as "{{name}} · Multiplayer"
install.baseNameHintOne: The name of the new client
install.trust: I trust the author of these executable files
install.trustHint: The bundle carries exe or dll files. JKNet cannot check what they do; VirusTotal links stand next to each of them.
install.done_one: Installed: {{count}} client is on the Clients tab.
install.done_other: Installed: {{count}} clients are on the Clients tab.

warning.jkhubDiffers: A file from JKHub is not the one the author had: jkhub.org serves a different version now. The client works with the current one.

description.openPicture: Show the picture at full size
description.pictureFailed: The picture could not be loaded.

contents.previewNeedsLauncher: Previewing the objects needs the launcher
contents.title: Contents of {{file}}
contents.moreMatches: The first {{shown}} of {{count}} matches are listed. Narrow the search to see the rest.
contents.noListing: This archive was published without a table of contents.

editor.autosave: Every change is saved as you make it
editor.notFoundTitle: The draft could not be opened
editor.componentGoneText: It was removed from the draft. Pick another one from the list.

overview.linked: This draft is bound to the published bundle {{bundle}}: publishing adds a version to it.
overview.name: Name
overview.nameHintTranslation: 2–64 characters, or empty to show the default language
overview.descriptionHint: Markdown, up to 32 KiB. The toolbar adds headings, lists, tables, links, pictures and videos.
overview.descriptionPlaceholder: What the bundle is, what it changes and who it is for
overview.tagsHint: Up to 10, separated by commas: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
overview.label: Version label
overview.changelogHint: What changed in this version, up to 4000 characters

languages.translation: Translation into {{language}}. A field left empty shows the text of the default language, {{default}}.
languages.copyHint: Fills the empty fields with the text of the default language
languages.removeBody: The name, the summary and the description in this language leave the draft. Players who read the launcher in it see the default language instead.

overview.linkText: The address the selected text points at. With nothing selected, the address itself becomes the link.
overview.videoText: The address of a video page, on a line of its own. A YouTube video plays inside the description; Twitch and VK Video open in the browser.
overview.imageTitle: Add a picture to the description

invalid.name: The name is 2 to 64 characters long.
invalid.translationName: A translated name is 2 to 64 characters long, or empty.
invalid.summary: The summary is at most 200 characters long.
invalid.description: The description is at most 32 KiB long.
invalid.link: A link is an http:// or https:// address.
invalid.video: A video is a link to a YouTube, Twitch or VK Video page.
invalid.tags: At most 10 tags, each 1 to 24 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
invalid.website: The website is an https:// address.
invalid.discord: The Discord link is an https:// address on discord.gg or discord.com.
invalid.label: The label is 1 to 32 characters long.
invalid.changelog: The changelog is at most 4000 characters long.

components.text: Each component is an engine with its own files and settings, and becomes its own client when the bundle is installed.
components.limit: A bundle holds at most 8 components
components.emptyText: Add an engine to start with: a multiplayer build, a single-player build, a demo player.
components.confirmBody: Its engine files, files and configs leave the draft. Shared files stay.
components.releaseHint: The build players get. "Latest at install time" follows the engine instead of pinning one.
components.label: Label
components.labelHint: Names the component in the bundle and ends the client name after an install: "Multiplayer", "Single player", "Demos"
components.invalidLabel: The label is 1 to 40 characters long.

engineFiles.loading: Reading the release archive… The first read downloads it.
engineFiles.failed: The release archive could not be read.
engineFiles.addTitle: Add files to the engine folder

files.empty: No files of its own yet. Add pk3 files, config files or anything the mod folder needs.
files.emptyShared: No shared files yet. A shared file goes to every component.
files.clientEmpty: This client has no files in its library.
files.clientTaken: The draft already holds a file at this path

configs.text: Config documents become layers of the client in this order; the shared documents of the bundle follow them.
configs.textShared: Shared config documents become layers of every client, after the component's own.
configs.name: Document name
configs.fromDocument: Copied from a document of the Configs screen; edits here do not change the original.
configs.tooLong: The text is longer than 64 KiB, which a bundle config may not be.
configs.passwordsNote: Lines that set a password are removed when the bundle is published or tested.
configs.pickEmpty: The Configs screen has no documents for this game.

launch.invalidFsGame: A folder name: letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.
launch.argsHint: Written as in a shortcut, up to 2000 characters
launch.invalidArgs: The arguments are at most 2000 characters long.
launch.modesHint: The ways the client starts; the engine offers these

preview.noComponents: Add a component to see the record.

publish.checkFailed: The draft could not be checked.
publish.clean: The draft is ready to publish.
publish.executables: Executable files: the version goes to an administrator for review before it appears in the catalogue.
publish.signInNote: Publishing needs a JKNet Online account.

test.title: Test {{draft}} locally
test.text: Makes clients out of the draft on this computer, the files copied from it. Nothing is uploaded.

issue.engineUnknown: A component uses an engine this version of JKNet does not know.
issue.noModes: A component has no launch mode ticked.
issue.emptyBundle: The bundle adds nothing: no file, no engine change and no config in any component.
issue.nameInvalid: The name is 2 to 64 characters long.
issue.tooLarge: The files to upload are larger than a version may be.
issue.executablesPresent: The bundle carries exe or dll files. The version goes to an administrator for review before anyone can install it.
issue.passwordsStripped_one: {{count}} line with a password is removed from the configs at publish time.
issue.passwordsStripped_other: {{count}} lines with passwords are removed from the configs at publish time.
issue.configTooLong: A config document is longer than 64 KiB.
issue.summaryTooLong: The summary is longer than 200 characters.
issue.descriptionTooLong: The description is longer than 32 KiB.
issue.imageMissing: The description refers to a picture the draft does not hold.
issue.unusedImages: The draft holds pictures the description no longer uses; they are not uploaded.

publish.signInText: A bundle belongs to a JKNet Online account. Sign in on the Settings screen, then come back to the editor.

upload.publishedText: {{bundle}} {{label}} is in the catalogue. Other players can install it from the Bundles tab.
upload.pendingText: {{bundle}} {{label}} carries executable files, so an administrator looks at it first. It appears in the catalogue once approved; the status is on your My bundles list.
upload.failedDraftRetry: The bundle stays on your My bundles list as a draft. Retry carries on with it; Start over forgets this try and leaves it there.

clientCard.linkHintDraft: {{bundle}} · {{component}}, from a draft on this computer
clientCard.customBuildHint: The bundle laid its own files over the engine, so a release update is not offered: it would write over them.
clientCard.busyInstall: A bundle is being installed into this client
clientCard.incompleteHint: The bundle install stopped before every file was in place. Resume it to finish.
clientCard.resumeHint: Continues the bundle install in this client; files already in place are kept
clientCard.playSingleHint: Starts the single-player game of this client
clientCard.createBundleHint: Makes a bundle draft with this client as its first component and opens the editor

mine.title: My bundles
mine.empty: You have not published a bundle yet. Build one on the Bundles tab and publish it from the editor.
mine.editHint: Opens the draft of this bundle in the editor
mine.editHintFetch: Makes a draft out of the latest version, which downloads its files, and opens the editor
mine.confirmBody: The bundle leaves the catalogue for everyone. Clients installed from it stay where they are.
